newsitem.title: UK: DHL forecasts UK import express growth.
newsitem.headline: DHL forecasts UK import express growth.

text.p: DHL International (UK) Ltd has forecast that by end-97 it will have gained seven percent of an estimated 100 million stg UK Import Express market.
It said it aims to have a 40 percent share by the end of the decade, the company said in a statement.

From July, DHL UK extended its Import Express service to 25 countries in South and Central America and the Caribbean. This has increased the service to a total of 73 countries, ahead of the company's own forecast for 1997 of a total network of 50.
The new additions to the service include Argentina, Honduras, Venezuela, Chile and Jamaica.
DHL said it plans to add the Middle East, China, India and Pakistan to the service by the end of the year.
